legal.disposition: Found guilty via no contest plea, sentenced to 24 months prison and 36 months extended supervision

event_summary.short: A teenage girl reported being kidnapped and strangled by her mother's boyfriend; when deputies responded, the suspect fled, leading a multi-county pursuit that ended with a crash into a tree. The suspect was arrested, injured, and later convicted.

timeline.initial_contact: Deputies dispatched to welfare check at a residence in Shawano, Wisconsin
timeline.pursuit_started: Suspect returned to area and fled when deputies arrived
timeline.arrest: After crash, suspect found incapacitated in vehicle
